scope: Actual Core fixed seeds, independent BASELINE/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH runs, strict save and deterministic 12-month reread. No per-person lottery or synthetic frequency script. Opportunity deltas compare the same observed opportunity; whole-world differences may propagate through legitimate outcomes and later RNG. Candidate 100-year stability/reign means were not instrumented; 200-year measurements include them. Timing/heap are not isolated performance benchmarks.
denominators: annual and legalTarget count formal country-year checks; army blockers count candidate-person checks; unique crisis facts deduplicate sources within each world; attempts/success/failure are independent committed transactions; world-years are not country-years.
